integrity.mathematical_basis: Explicit normalized outer-product bijections and finite-field pairing counts; direct exhaustive independent checkers

scientific_limitations: Only nonzero rank-one square-zero factors; does not concern arbitrary nilpotent ranks or products of three or more factors.
Characteristic is unrestricted, but the coefficient ring must be a finite field.
Existence of nilpotent factorizations and the exceptional two-dimensional obstruction are classical; novelty is assessed only for exact multiplicities and the reversed-product law.
Finite computations corroborate but do not prove the all-dimension theorem; historical priority is not independently established.
title: Complete multiplication fibers of the minimal nonzero nilpotent orbit over finite fields
